list: Don’t forget to fill out and turn in the Pulpit Committee questionnaire. You can drop yours in the box in the foyer.
The Eliza Broadus State mission offering goal is $2,500.

Women on Mission will meet Monday, October 12th in the Lewis Fellowship Hall. The Christmas Shoeboxes will be put together during this meeting. Sylvia Robinson and Lisa Thomas will provide the food. All women are encouraged and invited to attend.

fighterVerse.text: … My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
